question: One's relatives or family
solution: She invited all her kith and kin to the wedding. आपके सगे-संबंधी या परिवार के लोग (रिश्तेदार)।

question: A small structure with one or more open sides used to sell merchandise
solution: There is a newspaper kiosk near the station. सामान बेचने के लिए बनी छोटी दुकान या गुमटी।

question: The sound of the funeral bell
solution: The knell of the church bell announced the death. अंतिम संस्कार के समय बजने वाले घंटे की शोकपूर्ण ध्वनि।

question: The inner soft part of a seed, fruit, or nut
solution: The kernel of a walnut is very nutritious. किसी बीज या मेवे के अंदर का खाने योग्य कोमल भाग (गिरी)।

question: The philosophy that human knowledge is limited by the mind's capacity
solution: Kantianism is based on the teachings of Immanuel Kant. यह वह दर्शन है जो मानता है कि मनुष्य का ज्ञान उसकी बुद्धि की क्षमता तक ही सीमित है।

question: A government by rulers who exploit public resources for personal gain
solution: The country suffered under a kleptocracy for decades. वह शासन व्यवस्था जिसमें शासक जनता का धन लूटते हैं (लूट-तंत्र)।

question: A small shelter for a dog
solution: We bought a new wooden kennel for our puppy. कुत्तों के रहने के लिए बना छोटा घर या कुत्ता-घर।

question: A natural skill at doing something
solution: He has a knack for making people feel comfortable. किसी काम को करने का प्राकृतिक हुनर या कला।

question: One who has a persistent neurotic impulse to steal
solution: The police realized the woman was a kleptomaniac. वह व्यक्ति जो चोरी करने की बीमारी से ग्रस्त हो।

question: A mental condition where a person feels an uncontrollable urge to steal
solution: Kleptomania is a psychological disorder, not just simple theft. चोरी करने की एक प्रकार की मानसिक बीमारी।

question: A person who spoils others' enjoyment
solution: A killjoy is a person who deliberately spoils the pleasure or enjoyment of others. वह व्यक्ति जो दूसरों के आनंद या मज़े में बाधा डालता है (मज़ा किरकिरा करने वाला)।

question: A government by the least qualified or most unprincipled citizens
solution: Kakistocracy is a system of government which is run by the worst, least qualified, or most unscrupulous citizens. अयोग्य और भ्रष्ट लोगों द्वारा चलाया जाने वाला शासन।
